captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic jet engine, partially cut open to reveal its complex internal mechanism. It features a curved, light-grey outer nacelle casing that partially wraps around the engine body. Inside, a detailed black fan assembly is visible at the front, with multiple angled turbine blades radiating from a central nose cone. Further back, the central drive shaft and inner housing layers are rendered in dark metallic colors, showcasing the multi-stage interior of a turbofan engine.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a jet engine with a cutaway view. The model should include a light-grey outer nacelle casing, a detailed front fan with angled black blades, and multi-layered inner engine components along a central axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly. First, it defines the outer nacelle using a cut cylinder or swept profile to create the open, curved casing. It then models the central rotor assembly, including a central hub cylinder and a radial array of fan blades created by extruding angled profiles and rotating them around the central axis. Finally, internal stator stages and nested inner cylinders are added to represent the engine core, all organized hierarchically into parent-child links with rotational joints where applicable.
